support_claim: The CRM row for MER-55 lists Meridian Energy Partners and billing records list Meridian Energy Partners LLC, but no observation links the CRM identifier MER-55 to the billed legal entity.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing identity evidence and name similarity is explicitly insufficient; the packet provides no shared identifier, explicit mapping, or other proof that crm:MER-55 and billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC denote the same legal counterparty. DISTINCT likewise requires evidence of distinctness, which is absent, so neither burden is met and UNRESOLVED is the licensed disposition.
